name: Be Santa
desc:
🎅 How FAR can you FLY Santa's Sleigh?!

How to play:
💵 Become Santa and fly a sleigh to collect cash!
🏢 Buy floors to build the tallest tower and fly farther!
🛷 Upgrade Santa's sleigh and collect reindeer to increase speed!
😄 Teleport to friends’ towers and race!

🎁 Can you save Christmas, deliver all the presents, and reach The North Pole?!
